_note: Every line of menu and story text, in English and Spanish. The build voices each line with the narrator voice in voices.json. Spanish lines need a quick check by a Spanish speaker before launch.

en.title.name: Wordbound
en.title.tagline: Read the runes. Break the seal.
en.title.comingSoon: World 1 opens in the next update. Stay ready.
en.settings.title: Settings
en.settings.hint: Tap any speaker to hear the words.
en.mic.title: Microphone test
en.mic.prompt: Press Start, then say the word: sun.
en.mic.ok: Your microphone works. Speak mode is ready.
en.mic.blocked: The microphone is blocked here. Tap mode still works for everything.
en.mic.unsupported: This browser cannot use speak mode. Tap mode still works for everything.
en.mic.nothing: No words came through. Try again a little closer to the mic.
en.mic.offline: Speak mode needs the internet. Tap mode still works for everything.

es.title.name: Wordbound
es.title.tagline: Lee las runas. Rompe el sello.
es.title.comingSoon: El Mundo 1 se abre en la próxima actualización. Prepárate.
es.settings.title: Ajustes
es.settings.hint: Toca cualquier bocina para escuchar las palabras.
es.mic.title: Prueba de micrófono
es.mic.prompt: Presiona Empezar y di la palabra en inglés: sun.
es.mic.ok: Tu micrófono funciona. El modo de voz está listo.
